title: 第007章 歌者刘邦，编曲者谁？
content_zh:
吕后进来之后，原先还十分热闹的家宴，顿时就变得有些冷清了，刘邦还是在大声的炫耀着自己当初的经历，在孩子们面前吹着牛，太子恭敬的坐在一旁，低着头，侧着身，很是认真的听着。
刘如意则是挺胸抬头，看向刘邦的眼里满是崇拜。
“只恨晚生十年，不能跟随阿父作战！”
刘如意大声的说着，意气风发，就连太子在他身边都仿佛被比了下去。
这句马屁弄得刘邦嘴都合不拢，戚夫人眼里冒着光，又靠近了刘邦几分，吕后只是冷着脸，看都不看他们一眼。
刘恢憨笑着，坐在最末席，也不掺和那些事，格外老实。
刘恒皱着眉头，看着面前丰盛的酒席，轻轻摇着头，不知在想着什么。
刘长一口吞下一大块牛肉，一口吃了一个橘子，狼吞虎咽，犹如松鼠那样，脸变得圆滚滚的，塞满了食物。
“你这孩子是怎么回事啊？皇后不给你饭吃嘛？？”
刘长这饿鬼一样的状态，让大吹特吹的刘邦都无奈的停了下来，有些嫌弃的问道。
“你说你的..你管孩子干什么？”
刘太公威严的说了一句，刘邦顿时就熄火了，刘太公在群臣面前相当给面子，可是私下里，他有些时候还是会“殴帝三拳”，刘邦也不敢跟这老头顶撞。
“吃吧，吃吧，一天到晚就知道吃...没出息的...”，刘邦低声嘀咕着。
“你小时候吃的也不少啊..你现在不也挺有出息的嘛？”
刘太公反驳道。
刘邦似乎也是想到了以前，咧嘴一笑，忽然问道：“阿父啊，你以前常说我没有赖以生存的本事，赚不到什么钱，没出息，不如二哥...你看现在我的事业和二哥比起来哪个大呢？”
刘太公一愣，别过头去没有看他。
刘邦放声大笑。
宴会继续，刘邦那是说的更欢快了，大概是酒喝大了，还开始放声高歌，刘长嫌弃的瞥了他一眼，急忙离开了这个噪音污染区。阿父这歌唱的吧，不能说是天籁之音，也能说是鬼哭狼嚎了。
可怕的是，这位大汉帝王并没有正确意识到这个问题，他还觉得自己唱的不错呢，那个不要脸的如意还给他打拍子，还弄得那么享受一样，刘长回到了刘恢的身边，两人边吃边聊。

“四哥，你怎么不吃？”
刘长看着刘恒面前空荡荡的餐具，有些好奇的问道。
“我不饿。”
“四哥啊...下次赴宴之前，你就别吃东西，从早上熬到晚上..这样你就能吃下去了。”，刘长好心的传授着自己的经验。
刘恒笑了笑，摸了摸刘长的头。
“别碰我头！”
“找个时间，跟你三哥道个歉...”
刘长忽然问道：“四哥，你能外出嘛？”
“不能。”
“那你那里有刀或者斧子嘛？”
“没有。”
“唉....”
刘长无奈的看向了刘如意，难道，只能向邪恶势力低头嘛？
刘邦正唱着歌，一回头，忽然注意到了太子刘盈身后的四个白胡子老头。
这四个老头坐在太子的身后，太子是皇子里唯一有资格带着门客赴宴的人。这四个都是陌生人，胡须雪白，看起来年纪比刘太公还要大，刘邦一愣，迟疑片刻，方才问道：“这四位是什么人啊？”
刘盈起身，再拜，回答道：“父皇，这四位是儿臣请来的宾客，儿臣正在虚心跟他们请教，学习治理国家的办法。”
“哦？”
那四个老头在刘盈介绍他们之后，也是走出来，拜见了天子，又说出了自己的名字。
“唐秉，崔广，吴实，周术拜见陛下！”
刘邦大吃一惊，急忙站起身来，“是你们啊！”

“这些年来，朕一直派人去寻访你们，想要让你们来辅佐朕，可是你们每次都是避而不见，现在又为什么要来追随朕的儿子呢？”
唐秉抚摸着胡须，认真的说道：“陛下一向轻慢高士，臣等不愿意自取其辱，可是我们听说太子仁厚孝顺，恭敬爱士，天下之人无不伸长脖子仰望着，期待为太子效死，所以臣等自愿前来，愿为太子效犬马之劳。”
刘邦大喜，笑着说道：“那就有劳诸位在今后辅佐太子了！”
四人为刘邦敬酒，随后彬彬有礼的坐到了自己的位置上去。
刘邦时不时看着他们，又看看自己的太子，他低声对身边的戚夫人说道：“你看他们，朕原先想要换掉太子，但是朕没有想到，这样的名士都愿意来追随太子，如今太子有他们的辅佐，看来是羽翼已成，难以动他了...”
“以后啊，不要再激怒吕雉了，恭敬的对待她，她这回真的是要成你的主人了。”
戚夫人忽然大哭了起来。
宴席上的众人惊讶的看向这里，戚夫人这才捂住了嘴，又低声的抽泣了起来。
刘邦大笑，大声嚷嚷道：“哭什么，快起来给朕跳舞吧！”
刘邦再次放声高歌，“鸿鹄高飞，一举千里~~羽翼已就，横绝四海~~横绝四海，又可奈何~~虽有矰缴，尚安所施~~”
刘盈听到这首歌，神色有些激动，脸色涨红，他终于让父亲以自己为傲了，终于得到了父亲的认可！在这一刻，他反而有些束手无策，手忙脚乱，笑得很是灿烂。
而刘如意看着母亲的脸，不知为何，他有些沮丧，他不再凑到刘邦的跟前，在刘邦的歌声里，他也默默回到了兄弟们的身边，低着头吃着饭，样子甚是郁闷。
吕后此刻正在跟老太公聊着什么，对宴会上发生的事情是熟视无睹，压根不理会。
当初，在刘邦有了换太子的想法后，她就找来了哥哥吕释之，让吕释之去找张良，要张良给自己想个办法，吕释之有些迟疑，吕后便擦着泪，说道：“若是大哥在，也不会让你来做这样危险的事情。”
这么一激，吕释之即刻答应，启程去找留侯，至于为什么找留侯而不是找丞相或者别的重臣？那是因为吕后觉得，能轻易解决这件事的人，只有那位天下无双的留侯。
当然，想让留侯开口也不容易，吕释之差点就要物理求人了，在他各种耍无赖要挟威胁之后，张良才无奈的告诉他：去请商山四皓来辅佐太子，这件事就可以解决了。
吕释之本来也不知道这四位连皇帝都请不动的大家是否会愿意出山辅佐太子，可是当他找到这四个人的时候，他们表现的却非常积极，太子的名声在民间的确很好，这些人不愿意辅佐刘邦，却愿意辅佐太子。
太子在见到他们之后也非常的开心，整日都以国事来请教，将他们当作自己的老师来对待，与他们相处的很好，四人也总是跟在太子的身后，监督他的言行，时刻劝谏，这才有了今天这一幕。
谁能想到，皇宫里的一首歌，编曲的居然是千里之外的留侯呢？
或许这就是决胜于千里之外，运筹于帷幄之中吧。

刘长缓缓挪动身体，偷偷的坐在了刘如意的身边。
“咳..咳..”
刘长清了清嗓子，想要引起他的注意。
“咳！咳！”
刘如意目不斜视，专心致志的吃着饭，看都不看弟弟一眼。
无奈之下，刘长又伸出手指来戳了戳刘如意的胳膊。
还是没反应。
当刘长的手指头开始戳自己的脸的时候，刘如意终于忍不住了。
“你要做甚？！”
面对气势汹汹的刘如意，刘长其实是不怕的，因为刘如意打不过他，也不敢打他，他是吕后一手养大的，在整个皇宫里，除了吕后和刘邦，谁也不敢跟他动手，但是，毕竟有求于人，刘长也只能讪笑着，不在意刘如意的暴躁。
“我想问一下..你平日里可以出宫吗？”
“不可以，只有太子可以，你问这个干什么？”
“那，我能借一下你的佩剑吗？”
气氛顿时变得沉默，刘如意眯着双眼，紧紧盯着面前的刘长。
“不是用来对付你的....”
content_en:
After Empress Lu came in, the originally lively family dinner suddenly became a little deserted. Liu Bang was still loudly showing off his previous experiences and bragging in front of the children. The prince sat respectfully aside, lowered his head, turned sideways, and listened attentively.
Liu Ruyi raised her chest and raised her head, looking at Liu Bang with eyes full of admiration.
"I only regret that I was born ten years later and couldn't fight with my father!"
Liu Ruyi spoke loudly and with such high spirits that even the prince seemed to be outshined by him.
This flattery made Liu Bang unable to close his mouth. Mrs. Qi's eyes were shining and she moved a little closer to Liu Bang. Empress Lu just had a cold face and didn't even look at them.
Liu Hui smiled naively and sat at the bottom of the table. He didn't get involved in those things and was extremely honest.
Liu Heng frowned, looked at the sumptuous banquet in front of him, shook his head gently, not knowing what he was thinking.
Liu Chang swallowed a large piece of beef and an orange in one mouthful. He devoured it like a squirrel, and his face became round and full of food.
"What's wrong with you kid? Why doesn't the queen give you food??"
Liu Chang's state of being like a hungry ghost made Liu Bang, who was boasting so much, stop helplessly and asked with some disgust.
"You said...what do you care about the children?"
Liu Taigong said something majestic, and Liu Bang immediately turned off the fire. Liu Taigong was quite proud in front of the ministers, but in private, he would sometimes "beat the emperor three punches", and Liu Bang did not dare to conflict with the old man.
"Eat, eat, you know how to eat all day long...you are worthless..." Liu Bang muttered in a low voice.
"You had a lot of food when you were a kid... aren't you quite promising now?"
Liu Taigong retorted.
Liu Bang seemed to have thought of the past, grinned, and suddenly asked: "Father, you used to say that I have no ability to survive, can't make much money, have no future, and am not as good as my second brother... Do you think my career is bigger than my second brother's now?"
Taigong Liu was stunned and turned his head away from him.
Liu Bang laughed loudly.
The banquet continued. Liu Bang spoke more cheerfully, probably because he was too drunk, and started singing loudly. Liu Chang glanced at him with disgust and hurriedly left the noise-polluted area. My father's singing can't be said to be the sound of nature, but it can also be said to be the howling of ghosts and wolves.
The scary thing is that the Han emperor did not correctly realize this problem. He still thought that he sang well. The shameless Ruyi even beat him up and made it seem like he was enjoying it. Liu Chang returned to Liu Hui's side, and the two chatted while eating.
"Fourth brother, why don't you eat?"
Liu Chang looked at the empty tableware in front of Liu Heng and asked curiously.
"I'm not hungry."
"Fourth brother...don't eat before going to the banquet next time. Stay up from morning to night...so that you can eat." Liu Chang kindly imparted his experience.
Liu Heng smiled and touched Liu Chang's head.
"Don't touch my head!"
"Find some time to apologize to your third brother..."
Liu Chang suddenly asked: "Fourth brother, can you go out?"
"Can't."
"Then do you have a knife or an ax there?"
"No."
"Alas..."
Liu Chang looked at Liu Ruyi helplessly. Could it be that he had no choice but to bow to the evil forces?
Liu Bang was singing a song when he turned around and suddenly noticed four old men with white beards behind Prince Liu Ying.
These four old men were sitting behind the prince. The prince was the only one among the princes who was qualified to bring guests to the banquet. These four were strangers, with snow-white beards, and looked older than Taigong Liu. Liu Bang was stunned, hesitated for a moment, and then asked, "Who are these four?"
Liu Ying stood up, bowed again, and replied: "Father, these four are guests invited by my ministers. My ministers are humbly consulting with them to learn how to govern the country."
"Oh?"After Liu Ying introduced them, the four old men also came out, paid homage to the emperor, and said their names.
"Tang Bing, Cui Guang, Wu Shi, and Zhou Shu pay their respects to Your Majesty!"
Liu Bang was shocked and stood up hurriedly, "It's you!"
"Over the years, I have been sending people to look for you, wanting you to help me, but you have always avoided me. Why are you following my son now?"
Tang Bing stroked his beard and said seriously: "Your Majesty has always looked down upon noble scholars, and I do not want to humiliate myself. However, we have heard that the prince is kind, filial, and respects his beloved people. Everyone in the world cranes their necks and looks up, expecting to die for the prince. Therefore, I come here voluntarily and are willing to work hard for the prince."
Liu Bang was overjoyed and said with a smile: "Then I will help you all to assist the prince in the future!"
The four people toasted Liu Bang, and then sat down in their seats politely.
Liu Bang looked at them from time to time, and then at his prince. He whispered to Mrs. Qi next to him: "Look at them, I originally wanted to replace the prince, but I didn't expect that such famous people would be willing to follow the prince. Now that the prince has their assistance, it seems that he has matured and it is difficult to touch him..."
"From now on, don't anger Lu Pheasant anymore, treat her respectfully, she will really become your master this time."
Mrs. Qi suddenly burst into tears.
Everyone at the banquet looked here in surprise, and Mrs. Qi covered her mouth and began to sob softly.
Liu Bang laughed and shouted: "Why are you crying? Get up and dance for me!"
Liu Bang once again sang loudly, "The swan flies high, flying thousands of miles~~The wings are ready, crossing the four seas~~Crossing the four seas, there is nothing you can do~~Although you have talent, Shang'an can do it~~"
When Liu Ying heard this song, she looked a little excited and her face turned red. He finally made his father proud of him and finally got his father's approval! At this moment, he was a little helpless and in a hurry, smiling brightly.
And Liu Ruyi looked at his mother's face. For some reason, he felt a little depressed. He no longer came to Liu Bang. In the midst of Liu Bang's singing, he silently returned to his brothers, eating his meal with his head down, looking very depressed.
Empress Lu was chatting with the old lady about something at the moment. She turned a blind eye to what happened at the banquet and ignored it at all.
At first, after Liu Bang had the idea of changing the crown prince, she called her brother Lu Shizhi and asked Lu Shizhi to go to Zhang Liang and ask Zhang Liang to find a way for him. Lu Shizhi hesitated, so Empress Lu wiped her tears and said, "If my eldest brother were here, I wouldn't let you do such a dangerous thing."
So excited, Lu Shizhi immediately agreed and set off to find Liuhou. As for why he went to Liuhou instead of the prime minister or other important ministers? That's because Queen Lu felt that the only person who could easily solve this problem was the unparalleled Liu Hou.
Of course, it was not easy to get Liu Hou to speak. Lu Shizhi almost asked for help physically. After he acted rogue and threatened, Zhang Liangcai reluctantly told him: Ask Shangshan Sihao to assist the prince, and the matter can be solved.
Lu Shizhi originally didn't know whether these four people who could not even be invited by the emperor would be willing to assist the prince, but when he found these four people, they were very active. The prince's reputation was indeed very good among the people. These people were not willing to assist Liu Bang, but they were willing to assist the prince.
The prince was also very happy after seeing them. He consulted them on state affairs all day long, treated them as his teachers, and got along well with them. The four of them always followed the prince, supervising his words and deeds, and always admonishing him. This is how today's scene happened.
Who would have thought that a song in the palace would be arranged by Marquis Liu who was thousands of miles away?
Perhaps this is the decisive victory from thousands of miles away, and planning within the strategy.
LiuThe leader slowly moved his body and secretly sat next to Liu Ruyi.
"Cough...cough..."
Liu Chang cleared his throat, trying to attract his attention.
"Cough! Cough!"
Liu Ruyi kept her eyes straight and concentrated on eating without even looking at her brother.
In desperation, Liu Chang stretched out his finger and poked Liu Ruyi's arm.
Still no response.
When Liu Chang's fingers began to poke his face, Liu Ruyi finally couldn't help it anymore.
"What are you going to do?!"
Facing the menacing Liu Ruyi, Liu Chang was actually not afraid, because Liu Ruyi couldn't beat him, and he didn't dare to hit him. He was raised by Empress Lu alone. In the entire palace, except Empress Lu and Liu Bang, no one dared to make a move with him. However, after all, Liu Chang could only laugh and didn't care about Liu Ruyi's irritability.
"I would like to ask...can you leave the palace on weekdays?"
"No, only the prince can. Why do you ask?"
"Then, can I borrow your sword?"
The atmosphere suddenly became silent. Liu Ruyi squinted her eyes and stared at Liu Chang in front of her.
"It's not used against you..."
